page.layout: One printed page, upside down, title page only. Top: title block centred. Middle: small italic lines, then an engraving. Bottom: imprint lines, centred. A small mark at the top left corner.
page.notes: The page is printed upside down, so the lines were read from the rotated scan. The title block is faint and many lines could not be read letter by letter; the imprint and the italic lines are very doubtful. The engraving in the middle of the page is described only, not transcribed. The top-corner number "2" is doubtful; the mark may be a foliation or a stain. Show-through from the reverse side is not transcribed.
